mail.limitation: Anchor and heuristic selectors only. Numeric field IDs and ownership are unresolved.

calendar_events.limitation: Inferred calendar class and source selectors. Class also includes non-event working-hours data.

calendar_recurrence.limitation: No supported recurrence mapping in the pinned atlas.

calendar_attendees_responses.limitation: No supported attendee, response, organizer or owning-account relation in the pinned atlas.

contacts.limitation: No supported local contact field map in the pinned atlas.

folders.limitation: Typed folder reference framing is inferred; it does not establish mailbox account ownership.

flags_categories.limitation: No supported local flag/category map in the pinned atlas.

attachments.limitation: Public source hints are not validated local attachment ownership or safe sidecar access.

accounts.limitation: No authoritative account ownership relation. Global merges cannot establish ownership.

rules.limitation: Local storage presence and mapping unknown. Full server-side rules are not assumed to exist in HxStore.

settings.limitation: Local settings presence and mapping unknown. Profile preferences are not evidence read by this tool.

evidence_levels.S: Static implementation inspected by prior security study at exact revision; semantics not thereby proven.
evidence_levels.T: Synthetic behavior or arithmetic reproduced by the prior security study. Not rerun in this desk.
evidence_levels.O: Upstream claimed observation, not independently reproduced against a real store.
evidence_levels.R: PR2050 hash-bound recorded observation; not rerun here.
evidence_levels.U: Unknown; no inferred semantic or ownership relation.

claims.limits: Source contract. No real block coverage reproduced.

Synthetic arithmetic confirms reserved +32..39 is covered by body CRC, not header CRC. SPEC.md:128,704 and article incorrectly say header CRC covers it. CRC is not ownership or cryptographic authenticity.
Synthetic CRC-block fixture proves model mismatch, not that every possible historical HxStore variant uses the Rust layout.
Supported observations, not a general property-ID decoder. Offsets relative to envelope except where object is named.
Encoding arithmetic and published example reproduced. Decoder assumes UTC. Earliest-tick send-time inference is not a general schema guarantee.
claims.name: .NET DateTime tick arithmetic

reusable_research.limitations: Prior review evidence reused with exact source pointers. No third-party installation, execution, dependency audit, real-store observation or new semantic confirmation.
reusable_research.evidence_origin: Prior security-study-result.json; evidence levels describe that study, not execution in this desk.
